messages:
alex: Heads/kv-dim mismatch surfaced after the qwen conversion run. Staging batcher showed a big tail.
alex: Quick repro: conversion script produced HF config without n_head, so head_size calc ended up wrong and KV stride is inconsistent.
alex: minimal snippet from the parsed config (note missing key):\n```\n{"hidden_size": 6144, "head_size": 64, "n_head": null}  # n_head missing in converted json\n```\n
maria: saw this in profiler too — for seq lengths >1024 token latency jumps 12ms -> 28ms p50->p95 on the same model. GPU occupancy drops during KV replay window.
maria: logs from the run: `kernel_select: chosen_kernel=int8_rope_opt, occupancy=0.43, kv_stride=4096 != expected 6144`\n
sophia: interesting — if n_head is null we sometimes fall back to head_size only, which makes kv_dim != hidden_size and triggers an odd memcpy path in the runtime that degrades perf.
sophia: also saw safetensors for that checkpoint missing metadata key `tensor_meta/shape` so loader defaulted to float32 loads instead of reading dtype tag.

alex: confirmed: safetensors was missing `metadata` root dict. That forced the conversion to write raw arrays and runtime picked scalar dtype float32 -> bigger memory traffic.

dev-bot: CI:conversion-checker passed on unit tests but warned: `WARN: missing n_head in hf_config.json` (non-fatal)

tim: immediate mitigation: route traffic for that model id to the smaller fp16 variant and disable continuous batching for requests with seq>1024 until we patch parser.
tim: proposed validation (quick) in HF parser: check keys exist and assert `n_head * head_size == hidden_size` and throw conversion error if mismatch.

alex: patch idea — add a conversion-time sanity check and a runtime assertion for model-onboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/981 (WIP)

sophia: minimal patch suggestion: in hf_parser.py add:\n```py\nrequired = ["hidden_size", "n_head", "head_size"]\nfor k in required:\n    if k not in cfg or cfg[k] is None:\n        raise ValueError(f"HF config missing {k}")\nif cfg['n_head'] * cfg['head_size'] != cfg['hidden_size']:\n    raise ValueError("inconsistent head/head_size/hidden_size")\n```\n
maria: profiling notes: when kv_stride != hidden_size we hit the slow path in `kv_replay()` and the batcher cannot reuse cached prefixes — that explains the p95 spike. Also int8 kernel selection sometimes triggers additional reordering leading to extra kernel-launch overhead.

tim: follow-ups: (1) add parser validation + conversion fail; (2) safetensors loader: detect missing metadata and refuse to onboard unless `--allow-legacy` passed; (3) add a runtime metric `onboard_config_issues` with labels for dtype/kv_mismatch.

alex: I'll own (1) and (2) until EOD. Filed a bug and assigned: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-3421

sophia: small workaround in runtime: if kv_stride mismatch detected, fallback to compatible kernel that does no stride assumptions (slower) but signal the model as "needs-reconvert" in console and block Dedicated onboarding by default.

dev-bot: deploy pipeline: conversion-checker v1.4.2 queued. Tests: conversion unit + safetensors meta checks.

maria: after proposed fixes we should run the seq distribution perf job across seq buckets [128,512,1024,2048] — I can schedule that and post results.

alex: final plan: add hard validation to conversion, loader refuses absent safetensors metadata (opt-in legacy), runtime fallback + metric, schedule perf job. Assign owners: alex/sophia/maria. :eyes: :bug:

tim: agree. ping @eng-runtime when PRs are up.
